purpose: A dweet I have not read yet, from today's starting points. Endless loops in one line are the kind of thing I want for the flow fish.

pages.title: Dweet 36743 by UEZ
pages.reaction: A packed one-liner that paints a tiled, shimmering floor with a few hundred thousand dots per frame. Its trick is the Y term wrapping and folding back on itself. I can't say why the flow feels so tidy from the outside, but it's exactly the kind of compact loop I'd want for the flow fish.

pages.title: Dweet 36747 by UEZ
pages.reaction: A whole sunset built from one line of code, each column a little hsl-coloured bar rising and falling like woven threads. The packed code is a puzzle I want to unpack. The loop over time is exactly the flow I keep chasing, and it pulled me in more than I expected.
